description: Re-pin the decay-sector q* (S=0, ε=0 pure bar-even; the μ-p-Q_β trio) with the extended k=31 exact ℚ(√3) bar-odd D-ladder (#3821), and quantify the effect of the extra terms 22..31 on q* and dq*/dQ_β vs the k≤21-era determination. Result (scope-(a) negative): q*=1.10997859303152… reproduced to >20 digits and ladder-order-INDEPENDENT (the extractor c3_target_at+Vol(4₁) carries no d_k); the bar-odd carrier O_K(q*) SATURATES by k≈12, so the k=22..31 terms change it by ~1e-27, ≳20 orders below q*'s experimental-Q_β floor (dq*/dQ_β≈−0.539). The carrier is anchor-blind (≠ the swinging empirical S), so the capstone's S=h·D(u) is schematic not a tight identity. The k=31 extension's value is to the divergence-class/resummation program, not to this pin. Ladder core reused from qbeta_dladder_* / qbeta_ck_sseries_exact_rational (not re-derived). No c_k wired; no fit; no tier change; q₀ stays CAL-2 calibrated (q* is a cross-check).

data.scope: (a) measurement; no c_k wired; no fit; no tier change; q0 stays CAL-2 (q* is a cross-check determination, not a new pin)
data.verdict: k=31 D-ladder re-pin of q*: q*=1.109978593031523288402328 reproduced to 3.43e-25 of the k≤21-era value; dq*/dQ_β=-0.5389653. The extractor S=c3_target_at+Vol(4₁) carries NO d_k, so q* is ladder-order-independent. The bar-odd carrier O_K(q*) the ladder refines SATURATES from k=31 (inside the pre-existing k=21 data): the extra terms 22..31 change it by |O_31−O_21|≈6.94e-29, ≳20 orders below q*'s experimental-Q_β floor for any realistic σ(Q_β) — and the carrier does not feed q* regardless. The carrier is anchor-blind (spread 1.24e-9) and is NOT the swinging empirical S, so 'S=h·D(u)' is schematic, not a tight identity (the swing is the 1/u³ extractor, #3636). VERDICT (scope-(a) negative, informative): the extended k=31 D-ladder does NOT sharpen q* or dq*/dQ_β; q* remains experimental-Q_β-limited. The k=31 value (#3821) is to the divergence-CLASS / resummation program (astronomically-high-k q-Gevrey), not to this finite-order pin. No c_k wired; no fit; no tier change; q₀ stays CAL-2.
